text:
Mia Nguyen: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp (js-sdk) produced a flurry of 429s for a new org at 9:02am PT. Root cause looks client-side.
AJ Patel: I'm seeing the same logs. Requests spike when pagination + preload run concurrently, no per-call backoff/jitter in sampleapp.
Boris Ivanov: The Go SDK adds randomized jitter to retry delays; the JS one currently uses a fixed 500ms delay. that can cause thundering when many clients retry in sync.
Camila Rios: Can you paste repro steps? I can try to reproduce locally.
Mia Nguyen: Steps: create org, call /v1/embeds bulk (20 items) then enumerate pages with cursor in parallel from the UI. sample code: 
```js
// sampleapp fragment
await api.embeds.create({ items });
const pages = await Promise.all(new Array(5).fill().map(() => api.embeds.list({ cursor }))); // parallel pagination
```
AJ Patel: ^ that's the main anti-pattern — parallel pagination without per-call sequencing + no client limiter. also our sampleapp bundler sets default concurrency pretty high on dev machines.
Boris Ivanov: Suggestion: add Pager.lock() helper and a Pager.serial() example in the sampleapp. also align JS SDK retry to jittered exp backoff to match Go. filed issue #4567 for SDK parity.
Camila Rios: Another wrinkle: auth refresh is synchronous in the JS SDK and can block the event loop, causing a thundering herd when token rotation happens. saw auth refresh logs overlapping with the 429 window.
ciara-bot: deploy-bot: rolling restart of sampleapp-alpha completed (build 2026-03-18T09:10Z)
Mia Nguyen: Proposed quick fixes: 1) add a safe Pager.serial() usage in onboarding tutorial 2) change JS SDK retry to jittered exponential backoff 3) make auth refresh non-blocking and add a client-side small semaphore for token refresh 4) add a short note in quickstart about cursor reuse + concurrent list calls.
AJ Patel: I'll draft a tiny PR for the Pager.lock helper and update the sampleapp example.
Boris Ivanov: I'll take the retry parity PR and include jittered delays + tests simulating a synchronized retry wave.
Camila Rios: I'll update the onboarding sample to show an await-per-page loop and add a small diagram in the docs.
Mia Nguyen: Cool — please add owners/links in #devex-issues and reference issue #4567 for SDK parity. tagging for follow-up: @AJ Patel, @Boris Ivanov. thanks :pray:
